book.name: Kolosi
book.title: Pol-ate kaapiya la vu hil bel-ate vu Kolosi

content: + o 4:1 Lev 25:43,53; Ep 6:9*Ham sen ham atu yêêv-ato, ond ham oo ambiing va nivalok vu hil sen latu hamate va kul-ate malis amuu-to be ham samu sil nivasa, in ham alak ni nambe hamate Omaaho Bop timu nando baandoni.
Yaanohak niwêêk osin yaambiing va nivalok
+ o 4:2 Ep 6:18; Pil 4:6*Ham amem naatum-ambe ham anohak niwêêk jak busin pin osin ham naapêêlis na vu Anutu.

+ o 4:3 Lom 15:30; Ep 6:19; 1Ko 16:9*Tonde yik ham anohak in hey naambe Anutu dôôvu hey-ambe tatekin mopaatôôv in hey naanêêl Kalisi-te vakasin vunin-ato langaah, yik vakasin-anju sen saaluus kalaambus in gêên-anjo.
+ o 4:4 Ep 6:20*Om ham oo anohak in nambe sa naanêêl yite vakasin vunin-anju nanjip langaah lôôt ond mem manyinjo lohvu.

+ o 4:5 Ep 5:15-16; 1Tes 4:11-12*De ham ambiing va nivasa vu hil vaalu sen me-lawii-having Yesuu-to, tonde ham-ame basap busin ti na malis e, nganjo ham oo ambiing kul jak busin pin in ham naatovu nôôn.

+ o 4:6 Ep 4:29; 1Pi 3:15*Tonde ham oo bakaas osin ham akam-ambe ham naanêêl vakasin anivasa jak busin pin, tombe mem ham alohvu nambe ham bakaas nivasa naambêênja vu omaahonôôn ti ti pin in dôôvu sil.
Pol wiing Tikikas ayuuh Onisimas lalaah Kolosi
+ o 4:7 Ep 6:21*Tikikas yoo le naanêêl sate va pin sen sa naawiing-ato vu ham. In sate omaaho daka sen Tikikas-anja ond yiiy halingg yi keen, in nawiing Omaaho Bop-ate kul anivasa having sa.
+ o 4:8 Ep 6:22*Ondeey saawiing laas in nambe naanêêl hey banyengg vu ham-ambe ham anjak ni naambe hey nando nambe tana, tombe biing-ambe ham alompayo ahelavis jak.
+ o 4:9 Plm 10-12*Ke, yik saawiing Onisimas laas having Tikikas. Onisimas-anja ond yik ham-anja ti, ond yate omaaho nivasa keen, om yuuh Tikikas oo le daanêêl va pin sen neep nganjôô-to vu ham.
Pol nêêl lava samu samu la vu hil Kolosi

+ o 4:10 Sin 12:12; 13:13; 19:29; Plm 24*Alistakas sen luus kalaambus having saa-to ond ka navu ham, tonde Maak sen Banabas gaandêê-to ond yik ka navu ham having. Om naambe naas balup vu ham ond ham oo gako yi jak nohvu sen saanêêl vu ham-ato.

Tonde Yesu Jastas ka navu ham having. Yik yaal yaal muu-jo, ond yaal Yuda sen yaal dawiing kul having saa-jo, in nambe lamiing-ambe hil ngeeyaata landukana gaving Anutu-te hil-ambe ganggin sil, ond yik yaal oo davu kaandu sa lôôt.

+ o 4:12 Kol 1:7*Tonde yik Epaplas aka navu ham having. Epaplas-anjo ond yik ham-anja ti, tonde tu Yesu Kalisi-te hil kul vaha, ond nalohak niwêêk lôôt in nambe Anutu dôôvu ham-ande biing-ambe ham baale niwêêk lôôt, osin ham naatu hil aniwêêk keen, tombe mem ham anjak va sen Anutu ka navu nambe yaambiing-ato pin ani vanuh.
Tombe sa naanêêl langaah vu ham naambe Epaplas-anjo yoo nawiing kul bopaata lôôt in nambe dôôvu ham osin hil Leodisia de hil Hilapolis.
+ o 4:14 2Ti 4:10-11; Plm 24*Ke, tonde dokta Luk sen yate omaahôô-jo ond yik yuuh Demas akand navu ham having.
Tonde ham naanêêl vu hil Leodisia naambe sa kangg navu sil, tonde yik ham naanêêl vu vêêh bop Nimpa gaving hil bel-ate sen dasupin hôôk yite bayêên alo be dalohak-ato naambe sa kangg navu sil having.

Ham naasevin kaapiyaa-jo jung na, le mem ham ambiing na vu hil bel-ate vu Leodisia in sil daasevin gaving. Tonde sim kaapiya sen sa kaavu la vu hil Leodisiaa-to ond yik lambu naas-ambe ham naasevin gaving.
+ o 4:17 Plm 2*Ham naanêêl vu Akipas naambe ganggin kul sen hako vu Omaaho Bop-ato nivasa, be yoo biing-ambe nôôn jak.

+ o 4:18 1Ko 16:21*Sa Pol, soo kaavu vakasin samu samuu-ja vu ham lak sa namangg, om ham akam bu sa in sa naahen nando hôôk kalaambus. Yik vakasin lung laa-ja. Anutu-te samu samu naas mando gaving ham.
